name: Troy Michalski
headline: Vice President of Professional Services | SaaS Delivery Leader | Portfolio & Program Management | Executive Stakeholder Alignment | Driving Implementation Success & Client Value
about:
With decades of experience in professional services, project management, and operational change management, I serve as Vice President of Professional Services, Enterprise Projects at Origami Risk. In this role, I lead teams managing large-scale, complex software implementations, ensuring strategic direction, operational excellence, and executive-level client engagement. 

My work focuses on driving continuous improvement across Origami Risk’s implementation practices, including engagement management, business analysis, solution architecture, configuration, quality assurance, and System Integrator partnerships. By leveraging my expertise, I contribute to solutions that address organizational challenges and deliver successful project outcomes.

experiences.description:
As VP of Professional Services, Enterprise Projects, Troy leads the professional services delivery teams which are focused on Origami Risk's largest and most complex software implementations. 

Responsibilities include providing strategic direction, operational oversight, executive-level client engagement and driving continuous improvement across the company's implementation practice, including engagement management, business analysis, solution architecture, configuration, quality assurance, and System Integrator partnerships and related enablement.
